    data["price"] = pd.to_numeric(data["price"], errors="coerce")
    repairs.append("Converted price to numeric")

    data = data.fillna({"quantity": 0, "price": 0, "total": 0})
    repairs.append("Filled missing numeric values with 0")

    data = data.drop_duplicates()
    repairs.append("Dropped duplicate rows")

upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
outliers = (data["price"] < lower) | (data["price"] > upper)
if outliers.any():
    data["price"] = data["price"].clip(lower=lower, upper=upper)
    repairs.append("Capped outliers in price")
